Hi Samir & Laura,

Thanks again for taking time earlier today — really helpful to understand BrightLayer's priorities. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary goals: reduce inference latency for edge apps, support private deployment (VPC/on-prem), and reduce per-token costs.
- Key constraints: procurement timeline targeting end of Q2, strict separation of customer data, KMS integration requirement.
- Stakeholders mentioned: Samir (product), Laura (infra), Jorge (security).

Next step: short 30-minute product intro focused on architecture and deployment modes (we'll keep it high-level; technical deep-dive can follow if useful). Suggested 30-min windows (local times shown PST / EDT):

1) Wed Mar 17 — 11:00–11:30 PDT / 14:00–14:30 EDT
2) Thu Mar 18 — 09:00–09:30 PDT / 12:00–12:30 EDT
3) Thu Mar 18 — 16:00–16:30 PDT / 19:00–19:30 EDT

Please pick an option that works and confirm which BrightLayer stakeholders you'd like to invite. I'll include a solutions engineer (Vivek) to run the demo and draft a short agenda. Attached: post-discovery-notes-20270315.pdf (summary of call and questions for procurement).

Ideal outputs from the 30-min intro: shared understanding of deployment options, next steps for procurement documentation, and agreement on scope for a technical deep dive.

Thanks,
